units.source_text: 薰中纳言的随从中有一个人，不知何时早就和这里的一个侍女结缘。

en.t: Among Kaoru the Middle Counselor's attendants, there was a man who had long ago, no one knew when, formed a bond with one of the waiting women here.

units.source_text: 两人谈话之时，男的告诉女的：“匂亲王已被皇上软禁，今后不许微行出游，必须闭居宫中了。

en.t: While the two were talking, the man told the woman, "Prince Niou has been placed under restraint by the Emperor; from now on he may not go out secretly and must remain shut inside the palace.

units.source_text: 又聘左大臣家六女公子为他的妻室。

en.t: He is also to take the sixth daughter of the Minister of the Left as his wife.

units.source_text: 女家早年就有此意，故亲事一拍即合，年内就要举行婚礼。

en.t: Her family had wanted this for years, so the match was agreed on at once, and the wedding is to be held before the year is out.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对此亲事全然不感兴趣，虽然闭居宫中，还是一味萦心于浮薄之事。

en.t: Prince Niou has no interest at all in this marriage; even confined in the palace, his mind is still fixed only on frivolous affairs.

units.source_text: 皇上和皇后屡次训诫，他终不听从。

en.t: The Emperor and Empress have admonished him again and again, but in the end he will not listen.

units.source_text: 我们的主人呢，毕竟和别人大不相同，他过分严肃，别人都讨厌他。

en.t: As for our own master, he is quite unlike other people after all; he is so excessively serious that everyone dislikes him.

units.source_text: 只有到这里来，你们都敬爱他。

en.t: Only when he comes here do all of you respect and love him.

units.source_text: 外人都说这种深情决非寻常可比呢。”

en.t: People outside say that such deep devotion cannot possibly be compared with anything ordinary."

units.source_text: 这侍女又将这话转告她的同伴：“他说如此这般。”

en.t: The waiting woman then passed these words on to her companion, saying, "This is what he told me."

units.source_text: 大女公子闻之，越发伤心失望了。

en.t: When the elder young lady heard this, she became even more sorrowful and disappointed.

units.source_text: 她想：“妹妹与此人缘尽于此了。

en.t: She thought, "My sister's bond with this man has come to an end here.

units.source_text: 原来他爱上妹妹，是未曾娶得高贵妻室期间的逢场作戏，

en.t: So his love for my sister was only a passing diversion while he had not yet taken a high-ranking wife,

units.source_text: 只因顾虑薰中纳言等责他薄情，故只在言语上假装多情而已。”

en.t: and only because he feared that Kaoru the Middle Counselor and the others would reproach him for being heartless, he merely pretended in words to be deeply devoted."

units.source_text: 这样一想，她也顾不上怪怨别人薄情，

en.t: Thinking this, she could no longer even bring herself to resent others for their heartlessness,

units.source_text: 但觉自己越发置身无地，神思昏乱，便倒身躺下。

en.t: but only felt more and more that she had no place in the world; her mind grew confused, and she threw herself down to lie there.

units.source_text: 她本已衰弱不堪，现在更不希望长生于世了。

en.t: She had already been terribly weakened, and now she wished even less to go on living in this world.

units.source_text: 旁边虽然没有客气的人，但自觉无以为颜，不胜痛苦，

en.t: Although there was no one nearby before whom she needed to stand on ceremony, she felt too ashamed to face anyone and was overwhelmed with pain,

units.source_text: 便装作不曾听见那侍女的话，独自就寝了。

en.t: so she pretended she had not heard the waiting woman's words and went to bed alone.

units.source_text: 此时二女公子在旁，由于“愁闷时”而打瞌睡。

en.t: At that moment the second young lady was nearby, dozing because it was one of those times of sorrow and weariness.

units.source_text: 她的姿态非常可爱：以肘代枕，沉沉入睡。

en.t: Her posture was very lovely: using her elbow as a pillow, she had fallen deeply asleep.

units.source_text: 鬒发如云，堆积枕畔，这景象异常美丽。

en.t: Her thick black hair, like clouds, lay piled beside her pillow, and the sight was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 大女公子向她注视了一会，历历回想起父亲的遗诫，不胜悲戚。

en.t: The elder young lady gazed at her for a while, vividly recalled their father's last instructions, and was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 她反复思量：“父亲没有罪障，不至于堕入地狱吧。

en.t: Again and again she thought, "Father had no sinful burden, so surely he cannot have fallen into hell.

units.source_text: 无论在何处，务请迎接我到父亲所在的地方去吧！

en.t: Wherever you are, please come to receive me and take me to the place where you are, Father!

units.source_text: 父亲把我们这两个苦命的女儿抛舍在世间，连梦也不曾托一个呢！”

en.t: You left us two unfortunate daughters behind in this world, and you have not even sent us a single message in a dream!"
